name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Accordion. Items are cases stacked so they share their lines; the open header is an ink flat that sweeps in, the content drops in by steps and the brush chevron turns in two steps. Hover thickens the label underline; disabled items keep the label on paper inside a tone frame. Radix needs type="single" | "multiple" on <Accordion>; Base UI does not.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/accordion". It wraps your own components/ui/accordion, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Stacked cases; the open one turns to ink.
meta.usage:
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/accordion"

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem value="a">
    <AccordionTrigger>Chapter 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>The long night.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

props.name: data-manga
props.description: Set on the root, the items, the triggers and the panels (accordion, accordion-item, accordion-trigger, accordion-content): hooks for your own CSS.
